const int M = 32;

using ll = long long;

int add(int a, int b) {
    int s = a + b;
    return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
}

int mul(int a, int b) {
    return (ll(a) * b) % MOD;
}

struct Mat {
    array<array<int, M>, M> a;
    Mat() {
        for (auto& row : a) row.fill(0);
    }
    int* operator[](int i) { return a[i].data(); }
    friend Mat operator*(const Mat& x, const Mat& y) {
        Mat r;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j)
                for (int k = 0; k < M; ++k)
                    r[i][j] = add(r[i][j], mul(x[i][k], y[k][j]));
        return r;
    }
};

Mat f[MAXD];
int k;

    for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) {
            int ni = (i == k) ? i : (i + off) % k;
            int nj = (j == k) ? j : (j + off) % k;

}

int sum_digits(ll n) {
    int ans = 0;
    while (n > 0) {
        ans += n % k;
        n /= k;
    }
    return ans % k;
}

    ll tmp = n;

        tmp /= k;

        f[i] = id;

    }

    ll cur = 0;
    ll pw = 1;
    --ndigits;

    Mat ans = id;
